# Submission Moderation Rules

These rules apply to farm shops, immigrant shops, and news submissions.

1. When in doubt, verify against the official website.
2. Place entries by submitted address (or geocoded address), not by name alone.
3. Same names may exist in different districts. Treat duplicate checks as `name + address` and/or coordinates.
4. Do not merge or publish ambiguous entries until location is validated.
5. Keep source links in the record when available for traceability.
6. News additions and news removals must always go through manual moderation before publication or deletion.
7. Source review must be viewpoint-neutral: do not remove an article only because it is from a controversial source; require a concrete policy reason (duplicate, factual error, broken URL, legal/compliance issue, or out-of-scope topic).
8. Obvious errors (for example dead links, clear spam, duplicates) may be marked for expedited review, but still remain pending until a moderator approves.
9. Manual news submissions must include an automatic neutrality pre-check summary (rating, flags, notes) in the issue metadata and local moderation log.
10. Record moderation decision and rationale in the issue thread for auditability.
